title: StockSmart Program Agreement Terms on Ending a Program — Notice Period, Closure and Buyback
content:
### Ending the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program

**Term 1.** Ending a program is the customer's own act by written notice; service continues during the notice period.

**Term 2.** A terminating program closes no earlier than the tier's notice days in calendar days after the date the written termination notice is received. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice is received; the program closes on the last day of the notice period or a later date the notice names.

**Term 3.** On closure all bins are removed with the removal reason program end, consigned stock is withdrawn at no charge, and, where the tier requires the buyback of special stock, all special stock Corbett holds for the program is billed once at the tier's buyback basis on one buyback invoice; catalog stock is never bought back.

**Term 4.** The early exit fee applies under the program fee rules when closure falls before the end of the minimum term; a customer may withdraw a termination notice before the closing date only by enrolling again, which is outside this charter.

### The notice clock

The clock starts from the date Corbett received the written notice, as recorded on the program. That date itself is not counted; day 1 is the day after it. The earliest closing date is the last day of the notice period; equality with that day satisfies the term.

**Hypothetical case, a 30-day notice period.** Written notice is received on 1 March. Day 1 is 2 March and day 30 is 31 March.

| Proposed closing date | Within Term 2? |
|---|---|
| 31 March (the last day of the notice period) | yes |
| a later date the notice names, such as 15 April | yes |
| 30 March | no — earlier than the last day of the notice period |

### Closure effects

| Stock or item on closure | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Bins | all removed, removal reason program end |
| Consigned stock | withdrawn at no charge |
| Special (non-catalog) stock Corbett holds | billed once at the buyback basis, on one buyback invoice, where the tier requires buyback |
| Catalog stock | never bought back |
